anchor: first finalized getSlot result returned during capture
selection: Keep the first 200 successful signature entries in the provider's newest-to-oldest chain order whose slots are in the frozen window. Fetch exactly those 200 getTransaction responses; retain null, error and transport failures without replacement. Do not seek another time window, provider or later signatures for a convenient candidate.
classification: Inspect each frozen top-level compiled instruction against official Whirlpool IDL discriminators; preserve unknown and remaining accounts. Record successful and failed transactions separately.
first_replay_eligibility: First successful transaction in frozen source order with exactly one top-level Whirlpool target, a complete legacy or v0 envelope, resolvable LUTs and dependencies, historical target/dependency binaries, exact account pre/post evidence, runtime context, and a clean S-1 boundary for the complete watched set. Record every rejection; no unbounded search.
same_slot_rule: For each fetched candidate, inspect all earlier transactions in its slot for writes to the prospective watched set. Any overlap is TransactionBoundaryStateRequired. Never substitute end-of-S or end-of-S-1 as transaction pre-state when the boundary is dirty.
failure_rule: If this provider cannot return the sample or exact historical evidence, retain the failure and stop at the acquisition gate. A new policy requires a separate phase and cannot replace this frozen sample.
